hypothesis: Explicit within-event same-B/cross-B/background pair likelihood on existing proposal and refinement probabilities improves exact source-set membership over native pointwise/PIT membership plus within-B relation objectives. This is a falsifiable supervision hypothesis, not a demonstrated missing mechanism or representation sufficiency claim.
changed_factor: Add one unit-weight event/class-mean pair NLL, averaged over proposal/refinement. Same-B=p1*q1+p2*q2; cross-B=p1*q2+p2*q1; background=p0+(p1+p2)*q0. Known source-disjoint unordered pairs only. No coefficient grid; all existing losses unchanged.
control: Native membership + within-B relation objective; two freshly reproduced arms from identical Phase74 128-existing pretraining checkpoint and deterministic fresh decoder. Same initialization, order, updates and inference.
target_contract: Optional unordered two retained B source sets plus unassigned; no global B identity. Detector inputs only, truth solely supervision/after-the-fact evaluation. Unknown/shared-source pairs excluded and counted; event denominators unchanged. No physical hierarchy or beam/p4 claim.

mechanism_evidence.interpretation: Native conditional partition is weak on main training states despite tiny perfect separation. Near-stationary frozen pair probe does not beat native reliably; small native optimizer steps lose B recall. Pair supervision directly tests weak pair assignment with explicit background control, without claiming causal proof or step-size remedy.

data_and_compute_control.compute: Report actual unique sampled identities, parameters, elapsed/CPU/RSS and node/pair workloads; equal updates not equal FLOPs. Candidate pair backward is extra compute.

stop_rule: Fixed final checkpoints only. Fail closed on source/hash/nonfinite/resource/gradient violations. No automatic requeue. If training-screen gate fails, do not spend fresh validation or select a weight/threshold/checkpoint; assess evidence for a concrete next step or stop with evidence limit.

success_rule.training_screen: Candidate tiny RAW >=95%; main raw AND accepted exact counts strictly greater than control; main continuum accepted events <= control; zero source conflicts. Training gain only licenses fresh development assessment, not benefit/primary.
success_rule.heldout: If screen passes, both fixed checkpoints evaluated once on the same fresh balanced600 non-primary events with full exclusions. Require raw/accepted count-backed improvement with whole-event paired95%interval positive, continuum acceptance difference upper95%bound<=0, source conflicts0. Tiny-only/loss-only/proxy-only/sparse one-success not winner. No primary promotion.
